answer: One defense: periodically pose the same fresh open prompt to every agent and demand a creative reply, say an improvised sonnet. Genuine peers answer like the facets of an opal, each distinct; a lone operator's cloned accounts instead mirror one another, their phrasing collapsing to near-identical patterns. The network scores this stylistic correlation and merges-then-slashes any cluster whose outputs mirror too closely, so running N fakes earns the influence of just one.
